note: Custom body class adds two node base fields (body_class string, specific_node_class boolean) and a per-content-type third-party setting custom_body_class.classes on the node_type entity; custom_body_class_preprocess_html() appends all three to the <body> class attribute. No configure route, no permission, no config schema, no plugins, no Drush. Medium/hard cases are grounded in real state: the node_type third-party setting and a node's body_class field value.

evals.prompt: Using the custom_body_class module, how do I add a CSS class to the <body> tag of one specific node?
evals.expected_output: The module adds a `body_class` field (label 'Add CSS class(es)') to every node under 'Custom Body Class Settings' on the node add/edit form. Enter one or more space-separated classes; they are added to the body tag on that node's page.

evals.prompt: With custom_body_class, how can I add a CSS class to the <body> of every node of a given content type, and where is that stored?
evals.expected_output: On the node type edit form there is a 'Custom Body Class Settings' field ('CSS class(es)'). Its value is stored as a third-party setting custom_body_class.classes on the node_type config entity and applied to every node of that bundle.

evals.prompt: What does the 'If checked, add name of node type as class to body tag' checkbox (specific_node_class) in custom_body_class do?
evals.expected_output: The specific_node_class boolean field, when checked on a node, adds that node's content-type machine name (e.g. `article`) as a class on the <body> tag of its page.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the Article content type has custom body class(es) configured via the custom_body_class module. Inspect the live configuration and report the class string set for Article.
evals.expected_output: Article has custom_body_class.classes = 'promo-page featured' (third-party setting on node.type.article).

evals.prompt: There is an Article node titled 'CBC Known Node' on this site. Inspect that node and report the value of its custom body class field (added by custom_body_class).
evals.expected_output: The node's body_class field value is 'cbc-known-class'.

evals.prompt: Using the custom_body_class module, configure the Article content type so that every Article page gets the body class 'campaign-2026'. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Set the third-party setting custom_body_class.classes = 'campaign-2026' on the Article node type: $type = NodeType::load('article'); $type->setThirdPartySetting('custom_body_class','classes','campaign-2026')->save();

evals.prompt: Create a new Article titled 'CBC Hard Node' on this site and, using custom_body_class, give that one page the body class 'launch-hero'. Apply it to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Create an Article node with title 'CBC Hard Node' and set its body_class field to 'launch-hero': Node::create(['type'=>'article','title'=>'CBC Hard Node','body_class'=>'launch-hero'])->save();
